title: Electric Spoons, Chopsticks May Help Cut Salt (1/2)
titleZh: 電子湯匙和筷子有助減鹽 (1/2)
summaryZh: 日本團隊推出電子湯匙和筷子，用微弱電流讓食物吃起來更鹹，幫助減少用鹽。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Health & Lifestyle

sentences.text: Researchers in Japan say they will begin selling new devices that will help people reduce how much sodium or salt they use to improve the taste of their food.
sentences.zh: 日本研究人員表示，他們即將開始販售新裝置，幫助大家減少為了提味而用的鈉或鹽。

sentences.text: The developers are from Japan's Meiji University and drink company Kirin, based in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 研發團隊來自日本明治大學，以及總部位於東京的飲料公司麒麟。

sentences.text: One new device is an electric spoon.
sentences.zh: 其中一項新裝置是電子湯匙。

sentences.text: It uses a small computer worn on a person's arm to send electrical signals to activate sodium atoms.
sentences.zh: 它靠戴在手臂上的小型電腦發出電訊號，來活化鈉原子。

sentences.text: The developers say the signals increase the food's salty taste.
sentences.zh: 研發者說，這些訊號會讓食物嚐起來更鹹。

sentences.text: The electric salt spoon will sell in Japan for around $120 beginning in June.
sentences.zh: 這款電子鹽味湯匙六月起在日本開賣，售價約一百二十美元。

sentences.text: Meiji University professor Homei Miyashita developed the spoon and, a similar device, electric chopsticks.
sentences.zh: 明治大學教授宮下芳明研發了這款湯匙，還有原理類似的電子筷。

sentences.text: The chopsticks will likely go on sale next year.
sentences.zh: 筷子則可能會在明年上市。

sentences.text: The recent announcement marks the first time the technology has been used in a product for sale to the public.
sentences.zh: 這次發表是這項技術第一次用在對外販售的商品上。

sentences.text: Last year, the effort gained a different sort of attention.
sentences.zh: 去年，這項研究得到了另一種關注。

sentences.text: It won the 2023 Ig Nobel Prize in Nutrition.
sentences.zh: 它拿下了 2023 年搞笑諾貝爾獎的營養學獎。

sentences.text: Organizers described the prize as recognizing research that makes people laugh than think.
sentences.zh: 主辦單位說，這個獎表揚的是先讓人發笑、再讓人思考的研究。

sentences.text: The devices both use a weak electrical current to send the sodium ions from food, through the chopsticks or spoon, to the mouth, where they create a sense of saltiness, said Mieszda.
sentences.zh: 宮下說，這兩種裝置都用微弱電流，把食物裡的鈉離子經由筷子或湯匙送進嘴裡，在那裡產生鹹味。

sentences.text: As a result, the salty taste enhances one and a half times, he said.
sentences.zh: 他說，結果鹹味會增強一點五倍。

sentences.text: Mieszda and his laboratory have explored ways that technology can interact with and create human sensory experiences.
sentences.zh: 宮下和他的實驗室一直在研究，科技可以怎麼和人的感官互動，甚至創造出感官體驗。
